label: Period Hair
description: Hair and grooming that dates an image as precisely as the clothes do. Periods covered: the roaring twenties, the great depression and wartime nineteen-forties, the nineteen-fifties, the disco era seventies, the eighties, and post apocalypse, and the grunge nineties.

items.name: shingled-bob
items.text: hair shingled close at the nape and set in flat marcel waves that catch light like corrugated metal

items.name: slicked-centre-part
items.text: hair oiled flat to the skull with a knife-sharp centre part, a hard shine and not one strand out of the plan

items.name: victory-rolls
items.text: hair rolled up and back off the face into two high victory rolls, the rest pinned into a soft sausage curl at the shoulder

items.name: short-back-and-sides
items.text: short back and sides taken high and tight, the top left just long enough to be combed over with water

items.name: bouffant-set
items.text: a salon-set bouffant lacquered into a shape that will survive the evening, ends turned under in a single obedient curve

items.name: greased-pompadour
items.text: a greased pompadour combed up at the front and back at the sides into a ducktail, a comb never far away

items.name: feathered-layers
items.text: long layers feathered back from the face and flicked out at the ends, parted in the centre and left to move

items.name: natural-afro
items.text: a full round afro picked out to a clean silhouette, edges shaped rather than cut hard

items.name: crimped-volume
items.text: hair crimped through the lengths and backcombed at the crown, held by enough spray to keep its height in wind

items.name: side-part-mullet
items.text: short and spiky through the top, left long and layered at the neck, one side pushed back behind the ear
items.text_short: spiked top, long at the neck

items.name: hacked-short
items.text: hair hacked short with a blade rather than cut, uneven at the ends, pushed back with the same hand that does everything else

items.name: bound-braids
items.text: tight bound braids kept close to the scalp so nothing catches, ends whipped with wire and thread

items.name: nineties-curtains
items.text: hair parted dead centre and feathered back into curtains either side of the face, length just past the jaw

items.name: nineties-crimped-half-up
items.text: crimped lengths with the top half pulled into a small clip, baby hairs gelled flat at the temples
items.text_short: nineties crimped lengths with a small top clip
